change: Emit AT-SPI state-changed:enabled/sensitive for stable nodes when enabled changes; emit state-changed:focusable when enabled && Focus action changes.
old_result: The native libatspi listener timed out waiting for state-changed:enabled when the Volume slider was disabled. The old provider reported states on query but sent no availability events.
fixed_result: A native libatspi client receives enabled, sensitive and focusable events with detail1=0 on disable and detail1=1 on re-enable for the same Volume object; state reads agree in both directions. Designer Unicode/text events, ThemeScope, history and save/reopen still pass.
limitations: Both libatspi regressions use isolated D-Bus sessions and headless fixtures with the production provider; neither launches Orca or signs a desktop reader record.
The old failure log was captured before the additional focusable assertion; it already fails at the first enabled event wait.
Windows Narrator/NVDA, macOS VoiceOver, real IME, Inspector, physical DPI/theme, drag/drop and complete platform record.json remain pending.
